web.title: Are Overseas Student Health Cover policies GST-free? - ATO
web.description:
# Goods and Services Tax Industry Issues  Health Industry Partnership
## Are Overseas Student Health Cover policies GST-free?
**Private health insurance is GST-free.**

Section 38-55(1) of the GST Act states that a supply of private health insurance is GST-free.
